generate_image.good_for: any new image; Z-Image renders text/signs well

generate_drafts.good_for: explore several seeds/ideas cheaply, then finalize the best one

generate_from_reference.good_for: variations, restyling, keeping composition/colors of a reference

generate_with_control.good_for: keep exact edges (canny) or human pose (pose) of a reference

inpaint.good_for: change one area: fix hands/faces, replace objects, new background

outpaint.good_for: extend the canvas, change aspect ratio

upscale.good_for: bigger/sharper final images; refine=True adds real detail (slow)

remove_background.good_for: transparent PNG cut-outs, product shots, stickers
